text:
katie: Heads up — Docusaurus build for versioned site failed on merge of the migration branch. Error shows duplicate anchor ids (slug collision) and one broken internal link that 404s after the hash was normalized. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 

docs-ci-bot: build failed: docusaurus build exited 1
log excerpt: "Error: Duplicate heading id 'deploy-to-prod' found in docs/guides/deploy.md and docs/reference/deploy.md"

eli: ahh this is the old MkDocs -> Docusaurus migration pain. MkDocs slugifier kept punctuation, Docusaurus removes it; two different headings ended up with same slug.

naveen: can you paste the two offending headings?

katie: from the CI archive:
```
# Deploy to prod (blue/green)
...
# Deploy to prod: blue & green
```
They map to the same slug `deploy-to-prod` in the Docusaurus pipeline.

marco: For Docusaurus v2, the default slugify is `github`-style: lowercased, strip punctuation, collapse spaces. MkDocs used a different slugifier. We need a canonical slugify in our migration script so docs keep unique IDs.

zoe: Also saw one internal link fail in the preview site: `/docs/guides/deploy#deploy-to-prod-blue-green` -> 404 because the hash generated in the markdown used parentheses and wasn't normalized. The link in the markdown was manually authored and not normalized during migration.

eli: Proposed quick fixes:
- add a small normalization pass in the migration tool that converts all heading IDs using Docusaurus slugify rules and writes explicit HTML ids where collisions occur (e.g., `<h2 id="deploy-to-prod-1">...`).
- run a post-migration checker that finds duplicate slugs across the repo and reports collisions as errors.
- run a link-check step that follows internal anchors and flags 404s.

naveen: I can whip up a script. Plan:
1) parse markdown headings, compute Docusaurus-style slug via this JS snippet:
```js
function slugify(text) {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^-]/g, '') // strip non-ascii (optional)
    .replace(/[\s]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\-]/g, '')
    .replace(/\-+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^\-|\-$/g, '');
}
```
2) build a map slug -> [file:line,...], detect collisions
3) for collisions, append a numeric suffix to subsequent ids and insert explicit HTML id lines right after the heading
4) update internal markdown links that reference the old (non-normalized) anchors using a mapping produced above

marco: For transparency, let's also record the canonical rules in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md so future authors know how anchors are slugified and avoid manual hardcoded anchors.

zoe: I'll open a small PR adding a `yarn docs:validate-anchors` script that (a) runs the slug collision check and (b) runs a headless puppeteer linkcheck across built preview to catch anchor 404s (follows hashes). Should we make this a required check on PRs touching `docs/**`?

katie: Yes please. Prefer a lightweight approach first: static slug collision check in GH actions (fast), then optional preview linkcheck step that runs for PRs with `ci/preview` label.

docs-ci-bot: CI: new job queued: docs/anchor-lint

eli: one more gotcha — code examples that include inline heading like `## Usage (advanced)` can produce brackets in slugs on MkDocs but not in Docusaurus. Migration should normalize those and preserve linkability by rewriting references like `[advanced usage](#usage-advanced)` to the normalized slug.

naveen: I'll prepare the normalization patch and a small README for the migration folder explaining the slug rules and the script usage. Target: patch PR #912 with the normalization commit today.

marco: Also recommend we add an editorial note in the migration guide: "Avoid manually hardcoding anchor hashes in cross-doc links; instead link using relative references or explicit HTML ids to be stable across generators."

katie: Sounds good. Can we also add a one-off commit to `main` that scans existing main docs for collisions (preemptively) so we don't hit this in future versioned site builds?

zoe: yes, after the script is merged I can run it in a quick job against `main` and open a follow-up PR for fixes.

katie: Thanks team. Small checklist before closing this thread:
- [ ] naveen: open normalization patch and collision fixer PRs
- [ ] zoe: add GH action docs/anchor-lint (static) and optional preview linkcheck
- [ ] marco: update CONTRIBUTING.md with slug rules
- [ ] eli: add migration note & examples for rewriting links
- [ ] katie: run the main-scan after PR merges

katie: tagging this thread to the PR and marking `docs/blocked` until the normalization PR merges.

naveen: starting work now, will ping when I have a draft.

docs-ci-bot: job created: docs/anchor-lint (queued)

katie: thanks all :rocket:
